name: apple-home
description: Read and control curated Apple Home Shortcuts from Codex or ChatGPT

interface.shortDescription: Ask your home. Make it happen.
interface.longDescription: Apple Home lets Codex and ChatGPT discover explicitly curated Home shortcuts, read the states they return, run exact device actions, and execute scenes. Everything stays local through Apple's Shortcuts command-line tool; physical controls require explicit confirmation.
defaultPrompt: What Home actions can you access?
